free_tier.stated: Unlimited total storage on the free tier: '拥有无限制的总存储空间'. The per-file cap is on the per-object field

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MB per file on the free tier: '不限空间大小，不限下载速度，只是限制文件大小，最大不超过100M/个文件'

retention.stated: unverified: the vendor home page as read states no share-link lifetime; account retention is not published

egress.terms: Free and explicitly unmetered: '下载不限速度，不限流量，不限次数，免登录下载'. The free product is ad-funded and the FAQ states 我们对下载速度不做任何限制

tooling: no official API. Reverse-engineered clients mount it: the OpenList Lanzou driver in account, cookie or link mode, and a mature unofficial Python wrapper, zaxtyson/LanZouCloud-API, which does login, list, upload, download, delete, move, folder operations and direct-link extraction, and whose README claims it works around both the file-type and the per-file size limits by splitting
chaining: Unlimited total times 100 MB per object is the pure per-record-unlimited shape: 20 TiB is about 210,000 objects, all inside one free account's allowance. The gate is that registration is SMS-only on a mainland number

limits.value: 100 MB per file on the free tier
no WebDAV on a free account; access is only through direct-link extraction

identity_cost.detail: the register form (pc.woozooo.com, terms on accounts.woozooo.com) asks for 手机号 plus an SMS code, then a username and password; it shows no email field and no country selector. A foreign-number path is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: Domains rotate constantly, across lanzou.com, lanzoue, lanzouj, lanzoux and lanzoul, and a share link that works on one suffix 404s on another, so a script must carry a domain list. The CDN host itself is geo-flaky.
